items: 【Powerful Performance & Optimisation】 Equipped with the latest high-performance processor and ample memory, this tablet delivers smooth multitasking and rapid app response. The Android 16 system further refines resource management, ensuring a more stable, efficient, and seamless user experience overall.

【Large Storage Space]】Dive into boundless possibilities with this 11.97-inch Android tablet, boasting 24GB RAM (8GB + 16GB expansion) and 128GB ROM. Need more space? Expand up to 1TB via an SD card, giving you ample room to store all your favorite movies, music, games, and more. With everything you love right at your fingertips, endless mobile entertainment awaits!

【Unique and Elegant Design】This Android 16 tablet boasts an Ultra HD 2000x1200 display, paired with a sleek straight-edge profile and a thoughtfully designed camera system (8MP + 16MP) — where sharp clarity meets refined elegance. Its body feels comfortable to hold, with a smooth touch that enhances usability, and has undergone rigorous testing to ensure reliable, long-lasting quality.

【Long-lasting Battery Life]】Packed with a massive 8000mAh high-capacity battery, this tablet pairs with Android 15's intelligent power management to easily handle all your daily needs. Even during heavy use — like marathon video sessions or extended work hours — it maintains impressive longevity, minimizing the hassle of frequent recharges.

【Rich connectivity options】 It supports Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 to provide high-speed and stable wireless connectivity. It is also equipped with a USB-C port to support fast data transfer and charging, and is compatible with a variety of peripheral extensions to meet the needs of various usage scenarios.
